function: no_learning (p. 10): UAV-swarm collaborative beamforming (excitation weights, placements) and routing are solved by Ford-Fulkerson and DM-PSO, a particle swarm heuristic; nothing is trained.
notes: Excluded as no_learning, p. 10: "heuristic algorithms ... present a feasible solution, which motivate us to propose a heuristic algorithm to solve the V-RPTRMOP". The DM-PSO 'diffusion model' only adds forward-process Gaussian noise to crowded particles (p. 10, Eq. 25: "noise is added to their current position"); no network is trained. Stage one is the classical Ford-Fulkerson max-flow algorithm (pp. 7-8). DRL appears only as a rejected alternative (p. 10: "DRL models require extensive training time ... rendering them unsuitable"). Baselines are heuristics (DE, GA, ABC, SSA, PSO) and routing protocols (p. 12-13). The PDF is arXiv 2501.05742v1 and matches the DOI: same title and authors as the Crossref record of 10.1109/TMC.2025.3583510.
